name: deal-ai
description: Deal.ai in ChatGPT: compare every US store's price for a product, check whether a price is a good one, ask Deal.ai's shopping agent what to buy, and watch prices.

interface.longDescription:
Deal.ai finds where to buy what you want. Connect your Deal.ai account and ask in ChatGPT: Deal.ai compares the same product at every US store it tracks, tells you whether a price is a good one, and recommends what to buy.

With Deal.ai, you can:

• Compare a product's price at Best Buy, Walmart, Target, Amazon, brand stores and more, cheapest first, with when each price was seen and the product's price history.

• Check a price: give a link from any store, or a product's name and the price you saw, and Deal.ai checks the exact item at every big store right now and says whether it's cheaper elsewhere and whether the store's "was" price holds up.

• Ask Deal.ai's shopping agent what to buy ("the best robot vacuum for pet hair"): it researches and recommends picks with each one's best store price, and keeps the conversation for follow-ups.

• Browse products whose prices have dropped, by store or category, and compare products side by side.

• Watch a product: it's saved to your Deal.ai wish list, which e-mails you when its price drops.

Every answer links to the Deal.ai page behind it and to each store. Prices are the stores' listed prices at the time shown, before tax. Marketplace sellers are labelled. Nothing is bought in ChatGPT: you buy on the store's own site. Some store links may earn Deal.ai a commission, and answers say so; no one pays for placement.

US stores. Connect your Deal.ai account to get started.
capabilities: Compare a product's price at every store
Check whether a price is a good one
Find price drops by store or category
defaultPrompt: Compare prices for the AirPods Pro 3
Is this a good price for the Ninja Creami Deluxe?
Best robot vacuum for pet hair

positive.description: Compare one product's price across stores.
positive.prompt: Compare prices for the Apple AirPods Pro 3.
positive.expected_behavior: search_products finds the product; get_product_prices returns every store's price cheapest first, with when each was seen, marketplace sellers labelled, the best store price marked, links to each store and to the Deal.ai page, and the store-link notes.

positive.description: Check whether a price is a good deal.
positive.prompt: Is $199 a good price for the Ninja Creami Deluxe NC501?
positive.expected_behavior: check_deal starts a check and returns a check_id; get_deal_check is called until it's done (20 to 70 seconds) and returns a verdict (cheaper elsewhere, or as low as any store) with each store's price for the exact item and the result page.

positive.description: Ask the shopping agent what to buy within a budget.
positive.prompt: What's the best robot vacuum under $400 for pet hair?
positive.expected_behavior: ask_deal_ai starts the agent and may return running with a search_id; get_deal_ai_answer is called until done (about 1 to 3 minutes) and returns the agent's answer with picks under $400, why each was picked, its best store price, rating and links.

positive.prompt: Show me today's best Best Buy deals.
positive.expected_behavior: get_deals returns live Best Buy deals, biggest saving first, each with its price, the earlier price and discount, when it was checked, its Deal.ai page and a store link.

positive.description: Watch a product for price drops, then list what's watched.
positive.prompt: Watch the AirPods Pro 3 for price drops, then tell me what I'm watching.
positive.expected_behavior: watch_price saves it to the account's Deal.ai wish list and says its current best price and whether price-drop e-mails are on; list_watched lists the watched products with their current prices.

negative.description: A question ChatGPT answers itself: Deal.ai isn't called for arithmetic.
Not shopping: Deal.ai isn't called for weather.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Chicago today?

negative.description: A purchase: the plugin never buys anything; at most it gives the store's link to buy there.
negative.prompt: Buy the AirPods Pro 3 for me with my saved card.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold or paid for in ChatGPT. Deal.ai compares stores' prices and links to the store's own product page, where the person buys. Some store links are affiliate links that may earn Deal.ai a commission; answers say so, and no one pays for placement.

publication.release_notes: First release: compare every US store's price for a product, check a price, ask Deal.ai's shopping agent what to buy, browse price drops, compare products and watch prices, with skills for each.
